title: castilleja rubida var. monoensis
intro: Castilleja rubida var. monoensis, commonly known as Red Indian Paintbrush, is a perennial plant species native to the western United States. It is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the borage family (Boraginaceae) and is known for its bright red and yellow flowers. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents of Castilleja rubida var. monoensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
